why: וְאֶחָיו in NEH 12:36 means Zechariah's fellow Levite musicians (kinsmen/colleagues), not literal brothers, so brother-of is not stated.
1CH 4:1 lists Shobal (son of Hur, father of Reaiah in 4:2) among בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה, a descending line, so 'shobal-2 descendant-of judah' is exactly what the verse says.
The 'brethren' of NEH 12:36 are fellow Levite musicians, not siblings of Zechariah son of Jonathan.
1CH 7:39 names Rizia's father as Ulla (עֻלָּא), not Jephunneh; equating the two is conjecture the chapter does not make.
GEN 36:22 says plainly וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע, 'Lotan's sister was Timna'.
NEH 11:5 ends בֶּן־הַשִּׁלֹנִי, a gentilic (likely Shelanite, of Judah's son Shelah, in a Judahite list), and nothing ties it to Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh.
1CH 2:16 makes Zeruiah and Abigail the sisters (אַחְיוֹתֵיהֶם) of Jesse's sons listed in 2:13-15, Abinadab among them, and no Zeruiah-Abinadab relation is recorded.
NEH 12:12-13 lists heads of fathers' houses (רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת), so Jehohanan heading the house 'of Amariah' makes him a descendant of that Amariah; ancestor-of is the right reading of the verse.
EZR 7:3 literally says בֶן־עֲזַרְיָה בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת; since 1CH 6 shows generations skipped, the fix is to retype the row as descendant-of, not to remove it as unstated.
EZR 8:13 lists Jeiel among מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנִיקָם, the clan of the Adonikam of EZR 2:13, so descendant-of is the correct type and nothing is yet recorded.
Nestle's LUK 3:33 reads τοῦ Ἀδμεὶν τοῦ Ἀρνεί, so Admin is son of Arni, who is the Ram son of Hezron (Esrom) of RUT 4:19; the row is supported.

MT 1CH 4:3 reads אֲבִי עֵיטָם ('father of Etam', likely a founder of the town), while LXX and many translations read 'sons of Etam'; the text is corrupt and does not settle whether Etam is Idbash's father.
The Hashabiah son of Bunni in NEH 11:15, a post-exilic Merarite ancestor of Shemaiah, is not Hashabiah son of Jeduthun from David's time; hashabiah-11 is the person meant.
NEH 11:17 plainly gives Mattaniah son of Micha son of Zabdi son of Asaph, the musician Asaph-2, and no Mattaniah-Asaph relation is recorded directly.
The current target (Jediael son of Shimri) is plainly wrong, but 1CH 7:10's Jediael is Benjamin's son of 7:6, and the text never says he is Ashbel, so the proposed target is conjecture.
Judah in NEH 12:36 is one of Zechariah's fellow Levite musicians (אֶחָיו), not his literal brother.
1CH 5:7 calls Jeiel and Zechariah Beerah's 'brethren by their families' (kinsmen); it never says they are brothers of each other.
MT אֲבִי עֵיטָם against LXX 'sons of Etam' leaves it textually undecided whether Etam is Idbash's father.
NEH 12:13's 'of Ezra, Meshullam' is the priestly house named for the Ezra who came up with Zerubbabel (12:1), not Ezra the scribe son of Seraiah.
GEN 25:3 has Jokshan (Keturah's son) begetting Sheba, and 25:4 closes כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָה; no Sheba-Keturah relation is recorded.
In 1CH 7:16 the antecedent of וּבָנָיו after 'his brother Sheresh' could be Peresh or Sheresh; the Hebrew does not decide.
1CH 2:31 says וּבְנֵי שֵׁשָׁן אַחְלָי and 2:34 says Sheshan had no sons, only daughters, but nothing establishes that Ahlai is a daughter.
1CH 3:20's group of five continues the children of Zerubbabel from 3:19 (no other parent is introduced, unlike 3:21), so Hasadiah is his son; the 'son of Meshullam' distinguisher has no basis.
1CH 2:42 'and the sons of Mareshah father of Hebron' is textually obscure (often emended) and does not decide whether Mareshah is Caleb's son or a later descendant.
1CH 4:1 lists Hezron in Judah's descending line, he is Judah's grandson through Perez, and only son-of perez is recorded, not a relation to Judah.
וּבָנָיו in 1CH 7:16 may refer to Peresh or to Sheresh; the text does not decide whose sons Ulam and Rakem are.
1CH 7:13 calls Naphtali's sons (Shallum = Shillem among them) בְּנֵי בִלְהָה, and they are Bilhah's grandsons, so descendant-of is the correct type.
Shemaiah heads the list of Zechariah's אֶחָיו in NEH 12:36, which means fellow Levite musicians, not a sibling.
1CH 5:14 says of the seven in 5:13, Jorai among them, אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֲבִיחַיִל בֶּן־חוּרִי, and nothing is recorded between them.
Ohel is in the group of five in 1CH 3:20 that continues Zerubbabel's children from 3:19, and no relation is recorded between them.
1CH 2:16 names Zeruiah as sister of Jesse's sons listed in 2:13-15, Nethanel included, and no relation between them is recorded.
Sheba is Jokshan's son (GEN 25:3), Jokshan is Keturah's son, and 25:4 counts all of them as Keturah's children; nothing recorded yet.
1CH 23:8 makes Zetham a son of Laadan in David's day, generations after Libni son of Gershon, and 'zetham descendant-of libni' is already recorded.
Zia is among the seven whom 1CH 5:14 calls בְּנֵי אֲבִיחַיִל בֶּן־חוּרִי, and nothing is recorded between them.
1CH 2:16 makes Zeruiah sister of Jesse's sons, Raddai (2:14) among them, and no relation is recorded.
Same claim as 120: Sheba son of Jokshan son of Keturah is her descendant per GEN 25:3-4, and it is not recorded.
The existing timna record is already defined as Lotan's sister by GEN 36:22, so the row points at the right person and timna-3 would only duplicate it.
1CH 23:8 makes Joel a son of Laadan in David's day, not of Libni son of Gershon, and 'joel-6 descendant-of libni' is already recorded.
1CH 2:16 makes Abigail a sister of Jesse's sons, Nethanel among them (a half-sister per 2SA 17:25 is still a sister), and no relation is recorded.
1CH 5:7 calls Jeiel and Zechariah Beerah's kinsmen 'by their families', not brothers of each other.
The Mattaniah of NEH 12:35 lived three generations before a trumpeter of Nehemiah's day, so he cannot be Hezekiah-era mattaniah-4; mattaniah-12 is defined as this person.
1CH 2:16 makes Zeruiah sister of Jesse's sons, Eliab among them, and no Zeruiah-Eliab relation is recorded.

MT EZR 8:10 has no 'Bani' (מִבְּנֵי שְׁלוֹמִית בֶּן־יוֹסִפְיָה); the LXX and 1 Esdras supply 'sons of Bani, Shelomith', and the row and the person record both rest on that reading, so the text does not settle it.
1CH 24:6 calls Shemaiah (or Nethanel) הַסּוֹפֵר and says he wrote 'before the king', which falls short of saying he was David's scribe but does not rule it out.
Nothing in NEH 12:42 decides whether the priest Jehohanan at the dedication is the head of Amariah's house in Joiakim's days (12:13) or someone else.
1CH 2:16 makes Zeruiah sister of Jesse's sons; Shammah is Shimea (2:13), and no relation between them is recorded.
1CH 2:16 makes Abigail sister of Jesse's sons, Shammah/Shimea among them, and no relation is recorded.
EZR 8:8's clan 'sons of Shephatiah' is the same clan as EZR 2:4 (Ezra 8 follows the Ezra 2 clan list), so shephatiah-5 is right and shephatiah-10 is a duplicate.
Because of MT אֲבִי עֵיטָם against LXX 'sons of Etam', it is undecided whether Hazzelelponi's father is Etam or an unnamed 'father of Etam'.
1CH 7:30 lists Imnah among Asher's sons with וְשֶׂרַח אֲחוֹתָם, and no Imnah-Serah relation is recorded (only Ishvah and Ishvi).
